  "per_column": [

    {"name": "positive_sentiment_words", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Positive lexicon count carries signal toward positive labels; a valid text-derived feature that does not restate the label."},
    {"name": "allcaps_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "All-caps usage often correlates with strong emotion/frustration; a legitimate stylistic predictor of satisfaction polarity."},
    {"name": "exclamation_mark_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Exclamation frequency reflects emotional intensity (positive or negative) and is a plausible, non-leaking predictor derived from text."},
    {"name": "question_mark_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Questions may signal confusion/dissatisfaction; weak but legitimate text-derived signal, not a restatement of the label."},
    {"name": "repeated_punctuation_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Repeated punctuation (!!!, ???) indexes emotional intensity; a valid stylistic predictor independent of the outcome."},
    {"name": "title_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Title length is a generic structural feature with weak but non-leaking predictive potential; permissible predictor."},
    {"name": "content_word_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Review length can correlate with satisfaction (e.g., detailed complaints); generic but legitimate predictor, not a restatement of the label."},
    {"name": "comparative_language_count", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Comparative phrasing (better/worse than) is a meaningful content signal about relative satisfaction; valid text-derived predictor."},
    {"name": "investment_complaint_words", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Domain-specific complaint lexicon count is derived from text and plausibly predicts negative satisfaction; not leakage since it precedes/derives independently of the label."},
    {"name": "product_failure_words", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Failure-term count is a strong, semantically targeted predictor of dissatisfaction, computed from the review content rather than the label."},
    {"name": "durability_complaint_words", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Durability complaint lexicon is a domain-relevant predictor of negative satisfaction; text-derived and non-leaking."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 12,
  "predictive_utility": 0.7,
  "rationale": "All added columns are text-derived features computed from title/content and none restate, decompose, or leak the label_pos outcome, so each qualifies as a legitimate predictor. The set combines targeted sentiment/complaint lexicons (negative/positive sentiment, comparative, investment/product-failure/durability complaints) that carry genuine semantic signal about satisfaction, plus stylistic intensity cues (allcaps, exclamation, repeated punctuation). A cluster of generic length/count features (title/content word counts, question marks) adds only marginal leverage. As a set they provide substantial, non-leaking predictive signal beyond the raw id/title/content, warranting a solidly-above-average utility score rather than a top score, since several features are redundant or weak."
}
